about.title: About Kubsei
paragraphs: Kubsei comes from a conviction: good software multiplies what people can do, and it should also reach the places it barely reaches today.

We design products that work on slow connections, on modest devices and in their users' own language. We start with creativity through plaart and will continue with tools for work, learning and everyday life.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data is processed when you visit kubsei.com. Our products have their own policies; plaart's is at plaart.app/privacy.

sections.title: 1. Controller
paragraphs: The data controller is {controller}. You can write to {email} with any privacy question.

sections.title: 2. What data we process
items: If you email us: your address and what you tell us, only to reply to you.
Technical data of your visit (IP address, browser) that our hosting provider logs to serve and protect the site.
paragraphs: This site has no forms, requires no registration and uses no analytics or advertising cookies.

sections.title: 3. Legal basis and retention
paragraphs: Emails are processed under our legitimate interest in answering your request and kept for as long as the conversation lasts and at most one year after. Technical data is processed under a legitimate interest in the site's security and kept by the hosting provider for a short period.

sections.title: 4. Providers
items: Vercel: website hosting. It may process data outside the European Economic Area under GDPR safeguards (EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework or Standard Contractual Clauses).

sections.title: 5. Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, object to or restrict its processing, and request its portability by writing to {email}. We will reply within one month.
If you believe we have not handled your request properly, you can lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es) or your local supervisory authority.
